Characteristic.Name: Non Coded Restrictions
Characteristic.Value: Vehicle can not operate on routes with track circuits of type TI21 without further investigation.
Operation in Level 3 is not supported.
Operation on an ETCS trackside subsystem that requires the on-board to support radio session initiated from wayside is not supported.
The Railway Undertaking is responsible to ensure that BL2 tracks where the vehicle is used do not use values of M_TRACTION undefined in susbset-026 section 6.6.3.2.3.

The system may show bad availability if used on infrastructure where ERTMS equipped wayside does not include balise messages telling the system to connect to the relevant RBC at the entry to Level 2 areas (Usually a packet 42 or 45 is installed in front of the transition border). The impact must be judged from case to case as it may vary from none to significant depending on the wayside design.

If the radio network must be changed on start up this will not be possible. The vehicle will have to pass a balise with relevant network information to be able to register to the network. The railway undertaking operating the system must be aware of this when evaluating if the system if compliant for use on a new route.
The system will have issues to be operated on wayside where there are balises placed in a radio hole that orders radio connection.

The OBU will respond erroneously to entry of train running number 0. Should the operation require the use of train running number 0 be used in operation the effects on the infrastructure where it is used must be evaluated. It may or may not work depending on how the RBC responds to the data received from the OBU.
An RBC cannot supervise the electrical compliance between the vehicle and the wayside.
The system will have issues to be operated on trackside that sends a link chain where the current LRBG is included.
Geographical position shall not be used according to the AOS RN drivers manual amendment [Ref. 2], section 7.2.

The onboard system shall not be used in areas where Track Condition Big Metal Masses may be sent by wayside. This restriction is communicated in the Red Book Project IORE EOS4 upgrade 1DOC-1088453 version 1.3, section 2.7.
The system cannot be used with wayside using Permitted Braking Distance (PBD). This restriction is communicated in the Red Book Project IORE EOS4 upgrade 1DOC 1088453 version 1.3, section 2.10.
The system will not behave well if run on wayside using transitions from L1 to L2 and that does not let the RBC retransmit the position report parameters after the vehicle has entered level 2.
The system will have issues when being used on L1 wayside using repositioning.
The system will have issues when being used on wayside sending two or more repositioning balises in the same link chain.
The system can not be used on wayside that uses balises with M_Version = 0.

The system may not be used on BL3 wayside where unlinked balise groups with the same IDs as linked balise groups. This restriction is communicated in the Red Book Project IORE EOS4 upgrade 1DOC-1088453 version 1.3, section 2.12.
The system may experience issues when operated on wayside where mode profiles do not overlap at all.
The system may not be used on BL2 wayside that uses "stop if in SR". This restriction is communicated in the Red Book Project IORE EOS4 upgrade 1DOC-1088453 version 1.3, section 2.13.
The system may not be used with Radio infill. This restriction is communicated in the Red Book Project IORE EOS4 upgrade 1DOC-1088453 version 1.3, section 2.11.

The system may only be used on tracks with single balise balise groups in specific conditions. This restriction is communicated in the Red Book Project IORE EOS4 upgrade 1DOC-1088453 version 1.3, section 2.14.

The system can not be used in a system that requires it to store more than 1000 KMAC values (requirement is for 2000 values). The railway undertaking operating the system must be aware of this when evaluating if the system if compliant for use on a new route.

If the driver presses Override in Stand By mode an MA request is sent, the correct behaviour would be to enter Staff Responsible without MA request. For wayside with another ESC parameter than SE-05-BoL2B3 or ESC-SE-01-HIL2 the behaviour must be evaluated.
If the system is to be used on trackside where ETCS national values are communicated in balises using D_VALIDNV > 0 and D_VALIDNV ≠ 32767 further analysis must be performed.
